query:
select
                meeting.id,
                meeting.group_id,
                meeting.activity_id,
                meeting.title as "title!: DIS",
                meeting.secure_voting
            from vote_meetings meeting
            inner join group_adminships admin
                on admin.group_id = meeting.group_id and admin.user_id = $1
            where ($2::uuid is null or meeting.group_id = $2)
            order by meeting.title::text
